parameters.command:
=BASE=/projects/migration-{{ $json.jobId }}
if [ ! -d "$BASE" ]; then echo "NO_WORKSPACE: $BASE"; echo BUILD_FAILED; exit 0; fi
TARGET=$(find "$BASE" -name '*.sln' -not -path '*/bin/*' -not -path '*/obj/*' | head -1)
[ -z "$TARGET" ] && TARGET=$(find "$BASE" -name '*.csproj' -not -path '*/bin/*' -not -path '*/obj/*' | head -1)
if [ -z "$TARGET" ]; then echo "NO_PROJECT_FOUND"; echo BUILD_FAILED; exit 0; fi
OUT=$(dotnet build "$TARGET" -nologo 2>&1)
CODE=$?
# Only the diagnostics the Error Fixer acts on, not the whole build log - it goes
# back into an LLM context. The sentinel is decided by the exit code.
echo "$OUT" | grep -E ": error |error NU|error MSB" | head -200
if [ $CODE -ne 0 ]; then echo BUILD_FAILED; else echo BUILD_SUCCESS; fi
